layers.name: Identity
layers.property: Every agent, model and human has one that survives restarts

layers.name: Capability
layers.property: Authority is granted narrowly, expires, and is revocable centrally

layers.name: Evidence
layers.property: Claims are checked against sources and reported as supported, unverified or contradicted

layers.name: Trust
layers.property: Records accumulate into facts about behaviour — counts, never scores about people

layers.name: Governance
layers.property: Policies, obligations, approvals and the workflows humans use to run all of it

layers.name: Autonomy
layers.property: ABSuite's own agents watch the record continuously and raise what a person should see

layers.name: Collective Intelligence
layers.property: Independent deployments verify each other's records without merging them *(accrues with adoption — one mechanism is built, [`packages/notary`](../packages/notary/), though it is not yet on the registry; the layer is the network, and the network needs deployments that are not ours)*

layers.name: Civilization
layers.property: Millions of agents, autonomous economies, planetary-scale accountability *(accrues with use — nothing here is a feature that can be written; it is what the lower seven become at scale)*
